title: End-to-end test: orchestrator -> flexagent serve agent -> sandbox-host
description:
Implement the full end-to-end test validating the complete agent loop RPC flow:
orchestrator creates sandbox, launches agent process, sends messages, tools execute
in sandbox, results stream back.

Sections: 14.2 (Integration Scenarios), step 14 of implementation order

Key deliverables:
- tests/integration/agent_rpc/ — E2E test suite:
  - Create sandbox via SandboxControl
  - Launch flexagent serve agent inside sandbox via LaunchProcess
  - Create agent session on remote agent-server
  - Send message, observe tool execution in sandbox, verify results
  - Session forking: fork conversation into multiple sessions with different prompts
  - Cross-agent resume: native loop conversation -> Claude Code session.jsonl -> verify
  - Connection drop recovery: kill agent process, ResumeSession on new instance
  - Graceful shutdown: SIGTERM -> drain -> verify clean exit
- SandboxControl + AgentService combined scenarios
- Event stream fidelity verification across the full stack

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc.md §14.2
- Test harness: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc-test-harness.md §19 (exit criteria)
- Depends on: aiag-rmv.4, aiag-rmv.5, aiag-rmv.6, aiag-rmv.7 (all prior tasks)
